Express time values as numbers of time steps from an origin time value

Source: R/vstretched_numeric_formats.R
time_values_to_torigin_offsets.Rd

Fast, reversible conversion of time_values to bare integerish; reversed by torigin_offsets_to_time_values(). Preserves time-time spacing in terms of nsteps.

Usage

time_values_to_torigin_offsets(time_values, torigin, time_type)

Arguments

time_values

vector of time values of time type time_type.

torigin

either (a) a single non-NA time value of time type time_type, or (b) a length-0 time value vector, in which case time_values must also be length 0.

time_type

string.

Value

bare integerish vector, with length matching that of time_values.

Details

Predefined time origin based on time_value ptype doesn't work (unknown representation wday for weekly), so this requires us to provide one. If even we don't know due to 0 rows in data structure, we can pass a length-0 torigin of the appropriate ptype, assuming that we'll continue to work with 0-row data structures.
